description: VICUS Districts provides planning and thermohydraulic simulation for heating networks. The provider distinguishes it from VICUS Buildings and documents network sizing, component design, GIS integration, pressure and temperature results and dynamic simulations. The provider is VICUS Software. Coverage: The tool is applied to the user-supplied heating network, not a fixed country. The page illustrates annual hourly calculations and describes simulation periods from seconds to years. Access: The provider offers a local desktop application for Windows and Linux and a demonstration contact route. Only product documentation was read. Licence and cost: The page presents professional software and a demo route. Licence (read on the provider page on 2026-09-28): commercial licence (VICUS; free student licence). Limitations: Building-energy features on the same page belong to a separate product and are not attributed to Districts here. Numerical accuracy was not tested. For infrastructure simulation it supports network capacity planning and comparison of district-heating designs. Related resources: For comparison, model-pandapipes also models pipe-network behaviour; no direct coupling is claimed.
